CodePilot 这几天也有不少的更新：

1. 支持了新发布的 Grok 4.6、DeepSeek V4 Pro 以及 GLM 5.3 模型。

2. 支持将你 Grok 会员里的图像模型甚至视频模型的额度，也都在 CodePilot 里面使用。支持对 Twitter 进行检索。

这样的话，你只要有一个 Twitter 会员，就可以在 CodePilot 里面白嫖 Grok https://t.co/jbcevqpvJb

for 2 years the smartest models were also the priciest. Grok 4.6 just broke that.

what the benchmarks show:

61 on the intelligence index. tied with GPT-5.6 Sol, behind only Claude Opus 5 (63) and Fable 5 (62).

$2 per 1M input, $6 output. 60%+ below Opus 5 ($5/$25) and GPT-5.6 https://t.co/mGVEzvtnpA

cheap only wins if the output holds up, though. a frontier model still needs a real prompt to earn its score on your work. here's how to prompt Grok properly:

https://t.co/HNWhXYVap6

paying more stopped meaning getting more. that's the whole story of this release.

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you'd rather pick models on cost-per-result than on brand name.
